Saved means a completed, hash-checked primary run. Pending can mean unstarted or currently training. Replay runs are excluded. The runner saves trajectories at run completion, so this is not a live epoch monitor.

Stability with predictive quality | 10 paired seeds

Each thin line connects the same seed across models. Each scatter point is one model/seed. A constant predictor has zero range but AUROC 0.5: stability alone cannot establish improvement. Only seeds with all three completed models appear in comparative plots; no missing run is imputed.

Within-seed primary contrasts

Negative values favour the first model for stability only. Zero means no observed difference. No significance stars, interim hypothesis decisions or new inferential tests are added.

Predictive quality as the probe moves

Faint lines show individual paired seeds; bold lines show their arithmetic mean, not confidence bounds. Position percentages are rounded to discrete token indices. Triplet variants are dependent observations.

Mechanism diagnostics | descriptive, not causal

Attention is averaged over layers, heads and valid queries before reading probe key mass. Zero attention excess is the uniform-attention reference; zero retention contrast means equal group means. Baseline has no retention gate. Signal membership is associated with observable event type. These plots do not prove causal importance or end-to-end information preservation.

Same content, moved probe | seed 20260908

First three sorted triplet IDs from the first available complete paired seed, chosen without looking at scores. Examples illustrate behaviour; all triplets contribute to the primary endpoint. The dotted line is the generator probability, not an additional model prediction.
